assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, raising concern for undiagnosed paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as a potential embolic source.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period.
The study addresses the documented diagnoses of G45.9, I48.91, and R00.2.
This study aims to guide anticoagulation therapy and rate control management based on the burden of atrial fibrillation detected.
The claim for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on reason code CO-197.
The required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date.
Coverage cannot be applied to this specific encounter.
The patient has the right to appeal this determination.
